title_en: Zhou Enlai: Commander of the Hidden Front
title_file_as: Zhou Enlai, Commander of the Hidden Front
publisher: China Youth Press (中国青年出版社)
rights: Translation © the translator. Original text © Mu Xin / China Youth Press.
source_ref: 隐蔽战线统帅周恩来, China Youth Press, Beijing, 1st ed. Jan 2002. ISBN 7-5006-4686-0.
description: A narrative history of the Chinese Communist Party's Central Special Section (Zhongyang Teke), the underground intelligence and security apparatus that Zhou Enlai built and directed in Shanghai between 1927 and the early 1930s. Drawing on veterans' testimony and archival material, Mu Xin reconstructs the section's four branches, its legendary agents—the “Three Heroes of Longtan,” the radio pioneers, the Red Squad—and the catastrophe of Gu Shunzhang's 1931 defection.
translator_note: This is an English translation of 隐蔽战线统帅周恩来 (“Zhou Enlai, Commander of the Hidden Front”) by Mu Xin (穆欣), China Youth Press, 2002, made from an image-only library scan with no digital text layer.

The book is a work of Chinese Communist Party history written from within that tradition; it is frankly partisan toward its subject. Where its factual claims can be checked against independent scholarship, the footnotes say whether the account is corroborated, uncorroborated, or contradicted, and the translation renders the source faithfully rather than silently correcting it.

The text was recovered by optical character recognition, verified span by span against the page images for every name, number, and uncertain reading, and annotated for a reader with no background in the Republican-era Chinese underground.
source_note: Image-only PDF scan, 582 pages, no text layer. Simplified Chinese, horizontal, China Youth Press 2002. Front matter carries a long photo-plate gathering (plate folios 1–~32, PDF pp. 3–34) on its own numbering, then a 3-page 前言 (PDF 35–37), a 6-page 目录 (PDF 38–43), and the body from PDF 44 = printed p.1. Body offset is a constant 44 (printed = pdf minus 44); the preface runs its own sequence, printed 1 = PDF 36. Library copy of Xidian University; a red oval seal and a barcode sit on the cover/verso. No embedded PDF bookmarks.
